text:
**Best all-around: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200 W panels.** It’s a well-matched kit: **2,042 Wh** of capacity, **2,200 W** output, and **400 W** of included solar. That gives you a better shot at replenishing the battery than a 2 kWh kit with just one small panel. [Generator & Backup’s comparison](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup) names it the most complete solar-backup kit in this capacity range.

If price matters more, consider the **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W panel** kit. It has a **2,600 W inverter** and accepts up to **1,000 W of solar**, but the included single 200 W panel may take **2–3 sunny days** to refill the battery. [See the kit and current listed price](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).

**Bottom line:** I’d pick the Jackery for the more useful included panel capacity; choose the BLUETTI if you want the lower-cost starting point and might add panels later. Solar charge times vary with sun, panel angle, and weather.

products: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The top pick is the Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 kit, which we don't sell, and its facts come from a third-party comparison; dealectric.com is only linked for the secondary BLUETTI option.
